data.text:
Meat Vyapari Sangharsh Samiti And ... vs State Of Up And 4 
Others on 19 November, 2024 
Author: Vipin Chandra Dixit
Bench: Vipin Chandra Dixit
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:180779-Db
Court No. - 40
Case :- Writ - C No. - 21705 of 2024
Petitioner :- Meat Vyapari Sangharsh Samiti And Another
Respondent :- State Of Up And 4 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Kriti Gupta,Rohan Gupta
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Sant Ram Sharma
Hon'ble Shekhar B. Saraf,J.
Hon'ble Vipin Chandra Dixit,J.
1. Heard learned counsel appearing on behalf of the parties. 
2.  This is a writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India wherein the petitioners seek the following reliefs:-
"i) To issue a suitable writ, order or direction nature of mandamus directing the Respondents not to insist to obtain NOC from the concerned Municipality as a Meat Vyapari Sangharsh Samiti And ... vs State Of Up And 4 Others on 19 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31378498/
1 condition precedent for grant/renewal of food license.
ii) To issue a suitable writ, order or direction nature of mandamus directing the Respondents to decide the pending applications of the members of the Petitioner Association for renewal of licenses within a stipulated period of time as may be determined by this Hon'ble Court. 
iii) Any other relief which this Hon'ble Court deem just and proper in the circumstances of the case may also be awarded to the petitioner. 
iv) Award the cost of the writ petition to the petitioner." 
3. Sri Rohan Gupta, learned counsel appearing on behalf of petitioners submits that insistence of respondent authorities to obtain a NOC from the concerned municipality as a pre-condition for grant/renewal of food license is not necessary as the members of association of the petitioner are merely petty food business operators which are not covered by the Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses) Regulation, 2011. He further submits that as per Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses) Regulation, 2011, the petitioners are not required to take any N.O.C. from the Municipal Corporation. He further submits that particular orders dated 15.1.2018 and 20.2.2018 passed by the Executive Officer, Nagar Palika Parishad, Loni, Ghaziabad does not take into account the actual substance of the letter issued by the Air Force Authorities and in fact mis-interprets the same. He further submits that the stand of the Air Force Authority is that if the proper adequate arrangement is made, these petty shops can operate in the particular area. 
4. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the respondents has vehemently opposed the submissions made by learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners. However, he has fairly submitted that this issue may be re-visited by the officer concerned after granting opportunity of hearing to the petitioners. 
5. In light of the same, the Executive Officer, Nagar Palika Parishad, Loni, Ghaziabad is directed to grant an opportunity of hearing to the petitioners and shall pass a reasoned order on the same within a period of eight weeks from date. 
6. With the above direction the writ petition is disposed of. 
Order Date :- 19.11.2024 Kpy (Vipin Chandra Dixit, J.) (Shekhar B. Saraf, J.)
